W1.text: the dense arm's post-cooldown row improves on the composed machine's same-seed banked row by >= 0.01 at BOTH seeds -> the dense gated write COMPOSES with the additive read; the write-form attribution owns that much of the residual

W2.text: improvement at one seed inside the 0.0119 seed band and no replication at the other -> PARITY-grade evidence (the C-2 read-form-dependence verdict's own phrasing), reported as measured, NOT banked as composing

W3.text: the dense arm lands WORSE than its same-seed baseline beyond the band -> the G2-under-softmax result REPLICATES under the additive read (the write form does not compose), reported as the refutation with the C5 mechanism rows attached

G1.text: any gain cell improving the same-seed baseline by >= 0.01 at 3401 -> the gain owns part of the residual (a config yield, the K16 convention); inside the seed band -> the inherited point stands, receipted

combined.text: the combined arm fires ONLY if either lever's seed-3401 row improves >= 0.01: dense + the best gain cell

second_seed.text: any arm whose seed-3401 improvement is >= 0.01 owes seed 3402 BEFORE any claim (the standing win-bar rule)

band_discipline.text: any arm whose post-cooldown row would put the machine AT OR PAST GDN2's 1.3521734476089478 is reported with BOTH scorings and BOTH seeds before any claim, and ESCALATED, not adjudicated here; any inversion of a standing quality conclusion escalates likewise
